# Builders FirstSource

> > Builders FirstSource (BFS) is a leading supplier of building materials, manufactured components, and digital construction solutions for residential and commercial builders across the United States.

The company provides comprehensive homebuilding services including trusses, engineered wood products (EWP), millwork, installation services, and the myBLDR digital platform. BFS operates through a nationwide network of locations and subsidiary brands, serving builders with end-to-end construction solutions from design to installation.

## Key Topics

- Digital Solutions Platform
- myBLDR Customer Portal
- Manufactured Components (Trusses, EWP, READY-FRAME)
- Building Materials & Lumber
- Project Management Tools
- Residential Construction Services
- Energy-Efficient Homebuilding
- Installation & Millwork Services
- Regional Locations (Iowa, South Dakota, Nevada, Texas)
- First Team Employee Recognition
- Home Plan Library
- Construction Optimization
- Lateral Systems
- Family of Brands
- Early Career Programs

## Core Services & Solutions

- [Services | Builders FirstSource](https://www.bldr.com/solutions): Overview of construction services including millwork, trusses, installation
- [myBLDR - Your Digital Homebuilding Platform | Builders FirstSource](https://www.bldr.com/services/customer-portal): myBLDR customer portal for project management, 3D previews, and ordering
- [All Locations | Builders FirstSource](https://www.bldr.com/location/all-locations): Interactive nationwide location directory for all BFS facilities
- [Manufactured Materials & Components - Trusses, EWP, Lateral Systems | Builders FirstSource](https://www.bldr.com/products/manufactured-components): Manufactured components: trusses, EWP, READY-FRAME, and lateral systems
- [Our Family of Brands | Builders FirstSource](https://www.bldr.com/who-we-are/family-of-brands): Portfolio of BFS subsidiary brands including PBC and Pleasant Valley Homes

## Digital Solutions & Tools
